title: Reinstatement Payment Worksheet
content:
Patient Financial Services worksheet — **Patient Payment Plans**: the reinstatement payment on a defaulted plan.

## The rule

The reinstatement payment is the amounts of every installment recorded missed on the plan ledger, less every arrears payment already posted on the plan ledger, plus a reinstatement deposit of one full regular installment, less a reinstatement credit of one half of all the extra-principal payments posted on the plan less than 6 whole months before today.

Each part of the reinstatement payment is taken to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up, the parts are added and the credit subtracted, and the reinstatement payment is the result.

## The parts

| Part | What it is | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| Arrears outstanding | The missed amounts less the arrears payments already posted | Every missed-installment line on the plan ledger; every payment posted as an arrears payment |
| Reinstatement deposit | One full regular installment (a share of 1) | The regular monthly installment standing on the plan |
| Reinstatement credit | One half (50 percent) of the extra-principal payments counted | Payments posted as extra-principal payments, dated less than 6 whole months before today |

The reinstatement payment is the arrears outstanding, plus the deposit, less the credit, each part first taken to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical defaulted plan)

Regular installment 95.00. Missed-installment lines for installments 6 and 7, at 95.00 each. No arrears payment posted yet. Extra-principal payments of 40.00 (two months ago) and 25.00 (four months ago), and one of 30.00 posted eight months ago.

| Part | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Arrears outstanding | 190.00 less 0.00 | 190.00 |
| Reinstatement deposit | one full installment of 95.00 | 95.00 |
| Reinstatement credit | one half of 40.00 and 25.00 together (65.00) | 32.50 |
| Reinstatement payment | 190.00 plus 95.00, less 32.50 | **252.50** |

The 30.00 payment posted eight months ago is outside the 6-month span and is not counted.

**Variant: an arrears payment already posted.** Had an arrears payment of 60.00 already been posted on the ledger, the arrears outstanding would be 130.00 and the reinstatement payment 130.00 plus 95.00 less 32.50, that is 192.50.
